text:
aldo: Quick sync from the postmortem - want concise owners + two-week checkpoints for the GPU autoscale actions: quota guardrails, scheduler tuning, headroom playbook, and alerting. Keep replies short.

sara: I'll coordinate. Plan: weekly checkpoints and a 48h validation run after any remediation.

miguel: I can own quota guardrails. Will propose numeric burst caps, a small credit bucket, and an emergency global throttle by Mon.

kevin: Scheduler experiments are mine. I'll test memory-weighted bin-packing, affinity hints for long-lived model pods, and limit group preemption to preemptible pools. Posting staging numbers Wed.

ashley: Headroom playbook + comms templates on me. Will include dedicated vs hosted policy, region-level checks, and the auto-rollout block. Draft Thu.

dmitri: Ops automation: ops-bot will post daily spare GPU snapshots and create a REM ticket if spare_gpus < 15% for 15m. Prototype alert and ticket flow by next Mon.

ops-bot: created-reminder: "GPU headroom weekly" every Mon 09:00 in #incidents. first_run_ts: 1970000400. jira-created: REM-9999 assigned-to: miguel; REM-10000 assigned-to: kevin; REM-10001 assigned-to: ashley.

sara: Owners recap: miguel (quota guardrails), kevin (scheduler tuning), ashley (headroom runbook), dmitri (alerts/ops-bot). Close this thread when tickets include PR links and initial drafts are posted.

kevin: Question - should staged rollout caps be tied to region-level headroom as well?

ashley: Yes - adding region-level gate and a manual approval step for Dedicated customers.

miguel: I'll add a short customer-facing FAQ for sales/admin overrides in the quota spec.

sara: Great. Thanks all. We will review progress during the weekly checkpoint. :thumbsup:
